annotations.title: Upload a reference image for a transparent video

description: Requires an approved AlertForge account connection. OAuth-aware clients should start AlertForge's secure authorization flow and ask the user only to sign in and approve. Setup: https://alertforge.ai/ai-agents#agent-setup. The builder's "Upload image". Send the image as imageBase64 (with mimeType) or as an https imageUrl; PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF up to 10 MB. A PNG that already has a transparent background is free and returns referenceImagePath straight away. Any other image needs removeBackground: true, which recreates the subject on a transparent background and spends 5 credits; it returns referenceRenderId -- poll get_video_reference_image_status until it is completed, then use its path as referenceImagePath.

imageBase64.description: The image bytes, base64-encoded (a data: URL also works).

imageUrl.description: Or an https:// link to the image.

mimeType.description: Required with imageBase64 unless it is a data: URL.

removeBackground.description: Defaults false. true removes the background (5 credits), like the builder's "Remove background" switch.

requestId.description: Optional UUID you choose; a retry with the same id returns the same background-removal job instead of paying again.
